lines.t: I had watched You calm the waters
Heard the thunder know Your name
Still the storm inside grew louder
But You called me just the same
You said "Come out where I'm standing"
My fear fought every breath
But love was stronger than my doubting
So I took that step
When I took that step, I met mercy mid-wave
When the wind tried to drown me, Your hand still gave grace
I sank in my weakness, rose in Your strength
When I took that step, my heart found faith
Every failure whispered louder
Saying I was not enough
Till Your voice cut through the chaos
With a greater kind of love
You pulled me from my sinking
Said "My child, don’t you forget
Faith’s not found in the boat you’re in
It lives in your next step"
When I took that step, I met mercy mid-wave
When the wind tried to drown me, Your hand still gave grace
I sank in my weakness, rose in Your strength
When I took that step, my heart found faith
[instrumental break]
Oh, I’ll walk where You lead me
Even out on the tide
If it’s You that I’m seeing
I don’t need to hide
Every wave is an altar
Where Your promise is kept
And every breath is a prayer
Like the one I wept
When I took that step, You met me halfway
You silenced my storm and called faith by name
I’ll never forget how Your hand still saves
When I took that step, my heart found faith
When I took that step, my heart found faith
When I took that step, my heart found faith
